text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, King! What is up? Laying eyes
on thine
splendid visage today hath
verily lifted my vibes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Um, Kawakami? You sound different
today...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm absolutely delighted you
noticed!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In my quest to become more refined, I
have
gained new knowledge from the
internet!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I wanted thee to be the first to witness
my
linguistic glow-up! Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right. How about I give you some
lessons? First,
we'll learn how to choose
the right diction.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please! That would be indubitably
fire!
